document_description: Declaration of 24 March 1894 ratifying the 26 June 1893 Lunda boundary tracing under the Lisbon Convention of 25 May 1891; effective 31 March 1894.
limitations: The act says it transcribes route limits approved in five commission minutes but those minutes and the referenced map are not included in this PDF.
Textual named river routes and partial latitude references do not georeference finite treaty segments or establish applicability to individual candidate geometries.
preservation: Complete PDF bytes retained, not an excerpt. Relevant printed pages 29–33; PDF pages 35–39.
source_title: Bulletin officiel de l’État indépendant du Congo, 1894
